industry_fit.rationale: <cite index="1-1,4-1">Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions manufactures vehicle wrapping films in over 500 colors, vinyl graphic films, automotive wrapping films, paint protection film, and architectural and automotive window film</cite>. <cite index="21-3,21-4">The company produces vehicle wrapping films with features such as Easy Apply RS adhesive technology for faster and easier installation with reliable durability</cite>. This is a perfect direct match for Tedlar's ICP targeting sign manufacturers, large-format graphics, vehicle wraps, architectural panels, and protective films.

size_revenue_fit.rationale: <cite index="13-1,13-12">Avery Dennison has 35,000 total employees with trailing 12-month revenue of $8.77B as of September 2025</cite>. <cite index="3-2,47-3">The company operates in over 50 countries with approximately 35,000 employees worldwide, operating in over 180 locations</cite>. This substantially exceeds Tedlar's preferred size threshold of $50M+ revenue and represents a Fortune 500 global enterprise with massive scale.

strategic_relevance.rationale: <cite index="21-4,26-3,26-4">Avery Dennison vehicle wrapping films feature reliable durability, with Supreme Wrapping Film using multi-layer cast vinyl technology for excellent dimensional stability and long-term outdoor performance with superior resistance to fading, cracking, and peeling</cite>. <cite index="24-2,24-3,26-23">Colored vinyl applications can last up to five years without fading, while black or white wraps can retain color for up to 12 years, with films lasting 5-10+ years depending on the series</cite>. While Avery Dennison manufactures its own protective films rather than purchasing overlaminates, their focus on outdoor durability, UV protection, and long lifespan aligns well with Tedlar's value propositions, though as a materials manufacturer they are less likely to be a direct buyer.

market_activity.rationale: <cite index="34-1,34-3">Avery Dennison exhibited at ISA International Sign Expo 2025 in booth #3837 from April 23-25 to celebrate 90 years of industry-leading vinyl graphic films</cite>. <cite index="32-1,35-1,35-6">The company exhibited at FESPA Middle East 2024 alongside 3M, Brother, EPSON, HP and Mutoh, showcasing sign vinyl, adhesives and wrapping films</cite>. <cite index="31-9,31-10">Avery Dennison completed a large-scale wrap project for DPD's European fleet, wrapping almost 30,000 vehicles and 4,500 trailers over three years</cite>. The company demonstrates exceptional market activity with major trade show presence and high-profile fleet projects.

qualification_summary: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions is a top-tier prospect representing a Fortune 500 global materials manufacturer ($8.77B revenue, 35,000 employees) with perfect alignment in industry verticals—producing vehicle wraps, architectural films, signage materials, and paint protection films. While they are a direct competitor to Tedlar as they manufacture their own protective film solutions rather than a potential customer, understanding their product positioning, durability claims (5-12 year outdoor life), and dominant market presence at ISA and FESPA events provides critical competitive intelligence for Tedlar's go-to-market strategy in the graphics and signage space.
